query:
SELECT fc.id, c.nome, fc.totalServicos, fc.totalProdutos, fc.totalGeral, fc.qtdServicos, c.meta as metaMensal
FROM faturamentoColaboradores fc
JOIN colaboradores c ON fc.colaboradorId = c.id
WHERE fc.id = 150021;
